text:
I took some time deciding between this place and another cafe across the street, and I'm glad I chose this one. It's a true little oasis in the middle of the city - very peaceful, cozy, and green. There is plenty of space for groups, and the mini "Hands of God" installation makes for a great photo spot.

The drinks were spot on - both the coconut coffee and the salted coffee were delicious.

A couple of practical details to keep in mind: ❗️they don't serve any food, so bring your own snacks if needed.
❗️Card payments aren't accepted either, only cash or local QR transfers.
❗️The staff barely speak English, so you might need to rely on hand gestures.

Still, it's a lovely spot to drop by for a great cup of coffee.

text:
Bước vào quán là cảm giác như đang lạc giữa một khu rừng nhiệt đới thu nhỏ. Cây xanh được bố trí khắp không gian, kết hợp với tiếng nước chảy và không khí mát mẻ tạo nên một cảm giác rất thư giãn. Dù ngồi ở góc nào cũng thấy gần gũi với thiên nhiên và có rất nhiều góc đẹp để chụp ảnh.

Đồ uống được pha chế ngon, trình bày đẹp mắt và giá cả hợp lý. Menu khá đa dạng nên dễ lựa chọn, từ cà phê truyền thống đến các loại trà và nước trái cây đều ổn. Nhân viên thân thiện, phục vụ nhanh và luôn niềm nở với khách.

Điều mình thích nhất là không gian xanh của quán. Đây là nơi rất thích hợp để hẹn hò, gặp gỡ bạn bè hoặc đơn giản là tìm một góc yên tĩnh để thư giãn và tận hưởng không khí trong lành. Nếu yêu thích những quán cà phê mang phong cách thiên nhiên, nhiều cây xanh thì mình nghĩ đây là một địa điểm rất đáng để trải nghiệm.
textTranslated:
Stepping into the cafe feels like being lost in a miniature tropical forest. Greenery is arranged throughout the space, combined with the sound of flowing water and the cool air, creating a very relaxing atmosphere. No matter where you sit, you feel close to nature, and there are many beautiful spots for taking photos.

The drinks are well-made, beautifully presented, and reasonably priced. The menu is quite diverse, making it easy to choose from traditional coffees to various teas and fruit juices. The staff are friendly, provide quick service, and are always welcoming.

What I liked most was the cafe's green space. It's a great place for dates, meeting friends, or simply finding a quiet corner to relax and enjoy the fresh air. If you love cafes with a natural, green ambiance, I think this is a place well worth experiencing.

text:
Đồ ăn: rất ít (chắc ăn lãi đậm), nguội lạnh và dở hơn các quán nhậu khác
Dịch vụ: ra món rất lâu, phàn nàn nhưng nhân viên hứa hẹn 10-15p có món nhưng đó là lời hứa suông.  Nhóm đặt 2 dĩa thì đem lên 1 dĩa và cuối tiệc vẫn chưa thấy dĩa thứ 2. Đỉnh điểm là xin dĩa chanh, 20p sau mới thấy đem lên. Mặc dù hôm mình đi là quán không đông (vì không full bàn)
Và lời xin lỗi là tặng 2 đĩa khoai lang nướng phô mai là không thể chấp nhận được. Tôi cần giảm tiền thẳng vào bill hoặc chủ quán nói chuyện xin lỗi trực tiếp. Bản thân mình cảm thấy rất khó chịu với cách xin lỗi như thế. Vậy mà nhân viên vừa cười vừa nói xin lỗi? Điều này giúp bạn ấy nghĩ rằng sẽ bỏ qua cho 1 dịch vụ tệ như vậy?
textTranslated:
Food: Very little food (probably to make a huge profit), cold, and worse than other pubs.
Service: Food takes a very long time to come out. We complained, but the staff promised 10-15 minutes, which was just an empty promise. Our group ordered two plates, but only received one, and the second plate was still nowhere to be seen by the end of the meal. The worst part was asking for a plate of lemon, and it took 20 minutes to get it. Even though the restaurant wasn't crowded that day (because it wasn't full).
And the apology of giving us two plates of cheese-baked sweet potatoes is unacceptable. I need a direct discount on the bill or the owner to apologize directly. I felt very uncomfortable with that kind of apology. And yet the staff were smiling while apologizing? Did this make them think they would overlook such poor service?

Các bạn nhân viên nhiệt tình và nhanh nhẹn, chịu khó chụp choẹt giúp khách. Mình gọi đặt bàn trước và kết quả rất là mỹ mãn. À còn các món thì không quá đặc sắc và khẩu phần hơi ít, nhưng thôi cũng phù hợp. Vibe nhạc trẻ và rap khá bắt tai. Tóm lại là tuyệt vời!
textTranslated: The restaurant is located right in the city center, so the streets are quite busy. There's a large alleyway nearby, making it convenient for cars and motorbikes to get in and out. The space is spacious and open, with a breezy atmosphere and just the right amount of greenery, so there are no mosquitoes. The food preparation area, located in the center, is also very eye-catching. The staff are enthusiastic and quick, and they're happy to help customers take photos. I called ahead to reserve a table and the result was excellent. The dishes weren't particularly outstanding and the portions were a bit small, but it was still acceptable. The pop and rap music was quite catchy. In short, it was fantastic!

text:
Good atmosphere. Pleasant staff but something was missed in translation. I asked the waitress for a recommendation and she pointed out a dish that looked good. I ordered a side and an appetizer. The side and appetizer came out quickly but I figured the meat needed some time to grill. It wasn’t busy as I sat there. I saw people who came after me get their food and I sat there patiently waiting. After 40 minutes I asked about my order and come to find out the waitress never ordered for me. She did repeat back my order but I wasn’t clear of what she said exactly. I assumed since she recommended the dish she had ordered it. So my dining experience turned out much longer than I wanted. I wish she had asked if there was something else I was waiting for as I sat there clueless.

It soured the experience. Be sure you understand exactly what is being said and if it seems like you’ve been sitting too long, ask before 40 minutes have gone by. Nice place, okay food.

text:
Wir waren hier für einen kurzen Kaffee-Stopp und haben eine Iced Chocolate mit Kondensmilch sowie einen Iced Matcha mit Kondensmilch bestellt. Der Garten des Cafés ist eigentlich sehr schön gestaltet, besonders mit der kleinen Brücke und den Fischen – das könnte wirklich eine tolle Atmosphäre sein.

Leider war unser Eindruck insgesamt nicht so gut. Um uns herum saßen viele chinesische Reisende, die sich leider nicht besonders rücksichtsvoll verhalten haben. Überall lagen Sonnenblumenkerne und andere Essensreste herum, wodurch alles ziemlich dreckig wirkte. Das hat das Ambiente stark beeinträchtigt und es war dadurch ehrlich gesagt nicht besonders appetitlich, dort gemütlich seinen Kaffee zu trinken. Wir waren am Ende sogar froh, wieder gegangen zu sein.

Die Bedienung war zwar in Ordnung, aber auch nicht wirklich freundlich oder aufmerksam.

Geschmacklich konnte uns der Matcha leider auch nicht überzeugen. Er war einfach nur sehr süß und hat überhaupt nicht nach typischem Matcha geschmeckt.

Der Ort selbst hat eigentlich Potenzial durch den schönen Garten, aber unser Besuch war leider keine besonders angenehme Erfahrung.
textTranslated:
We stopped here for a quick coffee break and ordered an iced chocolate with condensed milk and an iced matcha with condensed milk. The café's garden is actually very nicely designed, especially with the little bridge and the fish – it could really create a lovely atmosphere.

Unfortunately, our overall impression wasn't so good. Many Chinese tourists were sitting around us, and they weren't very considerate. Sunflower seeds and other food scraps were scattered everywhere, making everything look quite dirty. This detracted significantly from the ambiance, and frankly, it wasn't very appealing to enjoy our coffee there. In the end, we were even glad to leave.

The service was adequate, but not particularly friendly or attentive.

The matcha also didn't impress us. It was simply very sweet and didn't taste like typical matcha at all.

The place itself has potential with its beautiful garden, but our visit was unfortunately not a very pleasant experience.

text:
Đây là lần thứ 2 quay lại quán và mình thật sự thất vọng về chất lượng phục vụ.

* Món ăn: hương vị chỉ ở mức tạm ổn, thời gian lên món khá lâu. Cách xử lý khi món ra chậm của các bạn mặc áo sơ mi rất lúng túng, thiếu chuyên môn nhà hàng.
* Khâu đón khách: không có ai chủ động tiếp đón hay dẫn khách vào bàn như lần trước mình ghé.
* Bảo vệ: thái độ chỉ dẫn chỗ đậu xe cho khách không tốt.
* Nhân viên phục vụ: tác phong chậm chạp, thiếu sự quan tâm và chăm sóc khách hàng so với trải nghiệm trước đây.
* Xử lý vấn đề: các bạn mặc áo sơ mi giải quyết những tình huống gia đình mình gặp phải khá rườm rà, thiếu dứt khoát.
* Mô hình quán: là quán nướng nhưng thực tế mình thấy chủ yếu là đồ nhậu, chưa đúng kỳ vọng.

Tóm lại, đây là một quán mà mình từng rất yêu thích cả về món ăn lẫn dịch vụ, nhưng sau 2 lần trải nghiệm gần nhất, mình thật sự không còn đủ niềm tin để quay lại.
textTranslated:
This is my second time returning to the restaurant, and I'm truly disappointed with the service quality.

* Food: The taste was only mediocre, and the food took quite a long time to arrive. The staff in shirts handled the slow service very awkwardly and lacked restaurant professionalism.

* Customer reception: No one proactively greeted or escorted us to our table like the last time I visited.

* Security: Their attitude towards directing customers to parking was poor.

* Waitstaff: Their demeanor was slow and lacked the attention and care for customers compared to my previous experience.

* Problem handling: The staff in shirts handled the situations my family encountered in a rather cumbersome and indecisive manner.

* Restaurant concept: Although it's a barbecue restaurant, I found it mainly served snacks and drinks, which didn't meet my expectations.

In short, this is a restaurant I used to love for both its food and service, but after my two most recent experiences, I really don't have enough faith to go back.

The service isn't particularly friendly, rather dismissive.

I didn't like the coffee at all; it tasted like instant coffee. 🙄

I initially considered giving it 4 stars. They really should have put some effort into the decor—lots of beautiful greenery, a waterfall, fish, it's quite pretty. DO NOT RECOMMEND!

text:
Tà Xùa Coffee offers a lush, tropical garden escape right in the city. Redesigned as a “tropical forest,” it features koi ponds, a waterfall, and rustic wooden furniture—creating a fairytale-like retreat  ￼ ￼. Retro‑80s decor and soft artificial mist further enhance the dreamy, Instagram‑ready vibe . According to TikTok and Instagram posts, visitors describe it as a “chill tropical vibes” oasis perfect for relaxing or snapping photos.

Tucked along a quiet alley off Cao Thắng, at number 16–17, it’s slightly hidden yet easy to find—close to the heart of Hải Châu. Open early (around 6:30–7:00) and running until 22:00–00:00, it’s accessible for both morning starts and late‑night hangouts.

The menu ranges from 30,000–55,000 VND, offering a good variety of coffees, teas, and iced beverages in line with other Da Nang cafés  ￼. While specific house specialties aren’t always noted, the café’s chill environment suggests a focus on relaxed enjoyment rather than gourmet experimentation.

Social media impressions emphasize the serene, friendly atmosphere. Patrons frequently highlight the spacious, green surroundings and tranquil ambiance—a true urban respite . Though official reviews are scarce, the abundance of videos and posts point to a positive reception.

text:
Không gian thoáng đãng, xanh, đồ ăn ổn. Mình thích nhất món gà nướng và cơm chiên hải sản.
Điểm trừ là phần đồ ăn ít so với giá tiền và không gian (ngồi ngoài trời, may hôm đi k nóng) Món dọn lên cực kì lâu và sai thứ tự. Đem nồi lẩu lên bật bếp sôi hết nước rồi mới đem đồ sống lên, lúc này công ty mình chờ lâu quá nhiều bạn đi về luôn 😳 Cơm chiên thì đem lên không thấy muỗng để xúc, xin muỗng thì đem ra đúng 1 cái, k hiểu kiểu gì.
Mình thấy nhân viên quán rất đông nhưng kiểu không đc training cẩn thận nên đâm ra lóng ngóng sao á.
Mình đi lần đầu dù đồ ăn ngon nhưng chắc k quay lại, mất công rước bực vào người.
textTranslated:
The space is airy and green, and the food is decent. I especially liked the grilled chicken and seafood fried rice.
The downsides are that the portions are small for the price and the space (outdoor seating, luckily it wasn't hot that day). The food takes an extremely long time to be served and is often out of order. They brought the hot pot to a boil, then brought out the raw ingredients, and by this time, many of my colleagues had already left because we had waited too long. 😳 The fried rice was served without a spoon, and when we asked for one, they only brought out one, I don't understand how that works.

I noticed that the staff were numerous but seemed poorly trained, making them seem clumsy.

Although the food was good, this was my first time going, and I probably won't return because it was a waste of time and I didn't want to get frustrated.

Here, the food is genuinely good, not just something to drink to get through the meal.

The service was quick, no long waits like at those crowded, snobbish places.

The price is very reasonable for a great drinking session.

In short: If I don't come back to this place, it's because… I haven't had enough to drink yet 🍻

Đồ ăn lên nhanh, món nào cũng đậm vị, đặc biệt mấy món nướng ướp rất vừa miệng, không bị khô. Nhậu lai rai là hết bàn lúc nào không hay.

This place is definitely the kind of place where you'll be hooked after just one bite and addicted to drinking there! 😆
The food comes out quickly, every dish is flavorful, especially the grilled dishes which are marinated perfectly and aren't dry. You'll finish all the tables before you know it.

The staff are enthusiastic and serve you immediately, unlike many other places where you have to wait a long time 👍
The space is airy and relaxing in the evening, perfect for groups of friends or casual drinks.

The prices are reasonable for the quality; I've been there several times and still feel it's worth the money.

Overall, it's my go-to place for gatherings; if you haven't tried it yet, you should definitely visit 😎🍻

text:
Tựa như một ốc đảo xanh mướt giữa lòng thành phố hối hả, bầu không khí mát mẻ trong lành bủa vây khi vừa bước chân vào quán.
Điểm nhấn của quán là hàng cây xanh lợp bóng chạy dọc giữa quán, bao quanh bởi hồ cá cùng dàn tưới, làm mưa nhân tạo đầy mát mắt. Ở cuối quán là thác nước chary róc rách cùng chiếc cầu nhỏ vắt qua với làn khoái lảng bảng như một Tà Xùa thu nhỏ.
Về đồ uống thì mình mới chỉ gọi 2 ly signature, nước ép ổn nhưng cà phê thì mình thấy cũng chưa đặc biệt lắm.
Giá tương đối mềm so với một quán cà phê đầu tư trang trí kỳ công.
Ngồi giữa tuần vắng khách thì thích hơn so với ngồi cuối tuần.
textTranslated:
Like a lush green oasis in the heart of the bustling city, a cool, fresh atmosphere envelops you the moment you step inside.
The highlight of the cafe is the row of shady trees running along the center, surrounded by a fish pond with an artificial rain-making system, creating a refreshing visual effect. At the back of the cafe is a babbling waterfall and a small bridge crossing it, with a gentle breeze creating a miniature Ta Xua.
Regarding drinks, I only ordered two signature drinks; the juices were good, but I didn't find the coffee particularly special.
The prices are relatively reasonable for a cafe with such elaborate decor.
Sitting there during the week when it's less crowded is more enjoyable than sitting on the weekend.

textTranslated:
A new restaurant opened next to my apartment, so I invited my friends to try it out.
The food was quite expensive and the portions were small.
Around 10:30, the staff asked if we wanted to order more food so the kitchen could close. After ordering 2-3 dishes, the manager said they would settle the bill at 11 PM and the restaurant would close. I asked if we could stay longer, just until 12 AM because we had work the next day, but the manager hesitated, as if wanting to get rid of us so they could close early. Then the manager came back and said we could stay until 12 AM, as if they were giving us extra time.
Regarding the bill, there was 8% VAT on the food + 10% VAT on the drinks. For a restaurant, the owner should include this on the menu so customers don't have to complain. When I asked, the manager said that the bill only stated that, but the prices were already included. I did a calculator and it turned out that it was an additional charge, not a pre-calculated price.
Terrible for a newly opened restaurant; it's sure to fail. I'm a regular at eating and drinking, so I know this place won't survive without a plan to address these issues.
First and last visit, it was terrible.

textTranslated:
Visiting Jam in September, oh my gosh, I can't believe how lovely it was! From the service, the way they talked, the way they took care of customers, and the amazing atmosphere. I loved it so much. I'll miss Jam a lot when I return to Hanoi, I'll recommend it to my friends, and I hope to see Jam again when I come back to Da Nang!

Our group received flowers and even photo albums. The staff member even set up the lighting for us. It's a little sad because my camera's memory card malfunctioned and I lost some photos. I'm temporarily keeping a few cute pictures in my locker. Hopefully I can recover them so I can upload them. Thank you so much to the enthusiastic and lovely staff member! 💝

Bonus: I found the drinks delicious! I thought they were just pretty, but they tasted great too!

text:
It works as an instagram backdrop but otherwise its a mediocre cafe.

Firstly the drinks: The coffee drinks are not good. The matcha is of low quality. Everything is loaded with sugar, and even if you ask it for without its still loaded with sugar and condensed milk because it is pre-made and you can't ask for it without sugar. The juices, basically the only non-caffeinated drink, are so stingy for 45k. It's basically 50% of what you get from a street stall that would sell it to you for 20k. So you get 50% of the quantity for 2x the price.

The cakes: The cheesecake (55k) isn't refrigerated. That tells you all you need to know about their professionalism and food safety handling.

Environment: yes it looks pretty, but the AC is weak and so if you come any time before 7pm it is way too hot inside even with their AC on blast.

The entire concept puts image over substance
Basic food safety ❌
Ensuring sufficient cooling ❌
Quality drinks ❌
Instagramable ✅

The place gets quite crowded in the evenings, making it lively and perfect for chatting with friends. The music selection is also very tasteful. The only downside is that getting there is a bit difficult because you have to go down a small alley, and the main road is often under construction. Otherwise, it's definitely worth a try.

textTranslated: I've been to this restaurant 2 or 3 times before, but this time it was truly unacceptable. I went to the restaurant, ordered, and then sat on the second floor. It was raining heavily, so I sat in a spot to avoid the rain as much as possible. I noticed the lamps and other restaurant items were on the table. I saw that the restaurant was busy, so I didn't rush to let the staff clean up immediately. But when the staff brought the drinks, they saw the table in that state and didn't even wipe it down. I waited for a while until the customers thinned out, and then I saw the staff standing in front of me, joking around, and not a single person came to clean up. Regarding the service, I didn't have high expectations, but the fact that there wasn't even a spoon for the customers or a glass of water is unacceptable. The problem is that the two previous times I visited, I ordered the same dish and they provided spoons and water. I understand that when it's busy, staff might forget things, but to joke around in front of customers without paying attention to them is unacceptable. I think the restaurant should review its service standards.

textTranslated:
I went to the cafe and ordered two drinks: Tokyo Fog and Coco Matcha. In my opinion, the Coco Matcha was a bit too sweet. I'm not sure if the cafe added sugar, but if they did, I think they shouldn't add more sugar syrup because the coconut water is already sweet, and adding matcha foam would make it more balanced, subtly sweet, and refreshing. I ordered the Tokyo Fog without sugar. I'm used to drinking it without sugar, so it was normal, but I thought it was just regular matcha with milk and Earl Grey tea, but it was matcha foam! 🥲 I don't like foam… but overall, it was okay.

🫯I went to chill and chat with a friend, but there were a lot of people taking pictures with flash, which I found quite annoying and bothersome. text:
이번 여행에서 먹었던 음식 중 손에 꼽을 정도로 정말 맛있었습니다! 🍣

특히 참치 스시는 입에 넣자마자 부드럽게 녹는 느낌이 정말 좋았고, 생선의 신선함과 밥의 조화도 훌륭했어요. 한 점 한 점 먹을 때마다 만족스러웠습니다.

음식의 맛뿐만 아니라 플레이팅과 전체적인 분위기도 깔끔하고 고급스러웠고, 마지막까지 세심하게 준비해 주신다는 느낌을 받았습니다.

“맛있다”는 말을 계속 하면서 먹었을 정도로 정말 만족스러운 식사였습니다. 😋
가격이 아깝지 않은 경험이었고, 스시를 좋아하시는 분이라면 꼭 한번 방문해 보시길 추천합니다.

다음에 다시 여행 오게 된다면 스시베는 무조건 재방문하고 싶은 곳입니다! ❤️🍣
textTranslated:
It was truly delicious, easily one of the best meals I had on this trip! 🍣

The tuna sushi, in particular, had a wonderful melt-in-your-mouth texture the moment it entered my mouth, and the harmony between the freshness of the fish and the rice was superb. I was satisfied with every single bite.

Not only was the food delicious, but the plating and overall atmosphere were also neat and luxurious. I felt that they took great care of every detail right up to the very end.

It was such a satisfying meal that I kept saying "delicious" while I ate. 😋

It was an experience well worth the price, and I highly recommend visiting if you are a sushi lover.

If I travel again, Sushi Be is definitely a place I want to revisit! ❤️🍣

text:
I had an appalling experience at this coffee shop.
First, I ordered a 'Red Rose' cold brew, which was served in a paper cup. When I asked for a glass, the staff claimed they were too busy to provide glassware. If that’s their policy during peak hours, why wasn’t I informed when I placed my order?

Secondly, I arrived with four friends. Upon entering, no one greeted us or mentioned whether there was available seating. We eventually found a small corner ourselves. Later, when a larger table opened up, we moved there, only for a manager to approach us and demand we split into groups of two to accommodate other customers.

Why try to cram customers into cramped spaces with such unreasonable requests? I decided to leave immediately, even though I hadn't even finished my drink. I strongly advise avoiding this place.

text:
View quán đẹp, không gian chill.
Tuy nhiên trải nghiệm dịch vụ khiến mình thất vọng. Mình chỉ mới uống vài ngụm nước, lên tầng 2 chụp hình rồi quay xuống thì bàn đã bị dọn sạch dù chưa hề báo trả bàn, trên bàn còn cả phong bao lì xì
Nhân viên giải thích do không thấy túi xách nên nghĩ khách đã rời đi. Theo mình, đây không phải lý do hợp lý để tự ý dọn bàn khi nước vẫn còn.
Mong quán xem lại quy trình làm việc vì cách xử lý này thật sự thiếu chuyên nghiệp
textTranslated:
The cafe has a beautiful view and a relaxing atmosphere.

However, the service was disappointing. I only had a few sips of water, went upstairs to take pictures, and when I came back down, the table had been cleared even though I hadn't asked to leave, and there were even red envelopes left on the table.
The staff explained that they assumed the customer had left because they didn't see my bag. In my opinion, this is not a valid reason to clear the table without my consent, especially when there were still drinks left.
I hope the cafe reviews its procedures because this handling of the situation was truly unprofessional.

text:
Quán được bày trí với đĩa than, máy quay đĩa, đèn chiếu film thập niên 80s và nhạc city pop Nhật thập niên 80s. Tone màu đỏ xuyên suốt. Có gu và có sự đầu tư, trau chuốt.

Có nhiều không gian khác nhau để ngồi, phù hợp với nhiều đối tượng, nhưng không hợp nhóm quá đông.

Vì quán đẹp nên các bạn trẻ đến chỉ mải mê chụp hình. Từ bên ngoài sân bước vào đã thấy trong nhà đèn flash giật sáng phanh phách, tưởng đi nhầm studio chụp ảnh. Vì các bạn chụp ảnh với flash quá nhiều khiến trải nghiệm tại quán không hoàn thiện, dù quán đẹp và bầu không khí rất ok.

Đáng tiếc hơn nữa là quán để yên như vậy và không có sự nhắc nhở nào.
textTranslated:
The cafe is decorated with vinyl records, record players, 80s film projectors, and 80s Japanese city pop music. The color red is used throughout. It shows good taste and a significant investment in attention to detail.

There are various seating areas to suit different groups, but it's not ideal for very large groups.

Because the cafe is so beautiful, young people are only interested in taking pictures. From the outside, you can see the flashing lights inside, making you feel like you've stumbled into a photo studio. The excessive use of flash photography detracts from the overall experience, despite the cafe's beauty and pleasant atmosphere.

Even more regrettable is that the cafe is left like this without any intervention.

textTranslated: The music was too loud, the decor was nice, and the drinks were okay, but I still felt uncomfortable, from the music to the staff taking my order. Initially, I clearly ordered a matcha latte that wasn't sweet, and they made me a new one, which I happily accepted. But then they brought it out again without any apology. Mình hỏi : mới hết món hay hết lâu rồi mà chừ mới báo thì bạn nhân viên ngập ngừng và bảo là hết món đó rồi. Sau đó 1 bạn nv nam bưng ra mình nhờ  gói lại thì bưng vào và chờ thêm 10p nữa.

Mình ngồi bàn ngoài, ngồi hơn 15p và phải kêu nv mới dọn bàn và lau cho mình và bàn bên cạnh. Nước lúc bưng ra thì thiếu ống hút, bàn mình xui là nó bị chênh cạnh.
Thực sự là có thể nhờ nhân viên báo chờ nếu làm lâu và hết món thì báo lúc mình order chứ? Thực sự lần đầu mình đi thử và  khá là mong chờ nhưng thực sự trải nghiệm quá thất vọng. Nếu có form cskh thì mình sẽ phản hồi ngay hoặc  sẽ gặp trực tiếp quản lý nếu có.
Thật sự là ngồi chờ gần 1 tiếng cho 1 ly nước ( cuối cùng ) đem về  và dịch vụ rất tệ, không đáng í
Mình chỉ nhận được 1 lời xin lỗi qua  loa của 1 bạn pha chế lúc mình hỏi nước xong chưa thôi.
textTranslated:
This was my first time trying it, so I had high expectations, but the experience was really disappointing, probably just bad luck.

I transferred the payment for my order at 8:04 PM, and about 30 minutes later, only my friend's drink was available. They said the matcha cream drink was sold out and they switched to something else. I asked if it was a recent sale or if it had been out for a while, and the staff member hesitated before saying it was gone. Then I switched to the salted matcha drink. I waited until almost 8:50 PM, then went to the counter to ask, and they said my drink was ready and asked to have it packed to take away. Then a male staff member brought it out, and when I asked them to pack it, they took it back inside, and I waited another 10 minutes.

I sat at a table outside, and after more than 15 minutes, I had to ask a staff member to clear and wipe down my table and the table next to me. When the drinks were brought out, they were missing straws, and my table was unlucky enough to have a crooked edge.

Seriously, couldn't they have asked the staff to inform me of the wait if something was taking a long time or was out of stock when I ordered? This was my first time trying it and I was quite looking forward to it, but the experience was really disappointing. If there was a customer service form, I would have responded immediately or spoken directly to the manager if there was one.
I honestly waited almost an hour for one (final) drink to take away, and the service was terrible, not worth it.
I only received a perfunctory apology from a barista when I asked if my drink was ready.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dạ quán thật sự xin lỗi bạn vì trải nghiệm không tốt trong lần ghé quán vừa rồi
Quán thật sự tiếc khi đã để bạn chờ đợi quá lâu, quán xin nhận trách nhiệm về sự thiếu sót trong khâu thông báo món, thời gian chờ đợi cũng như chất lượng phục vụ của nhân viên trong hôm đó.

Quán rất tiếc vì đã làm bạn thất vọng, đặc biệt khi đây là lần đầu bạn đến và đã có nhiều mong đợi. Bên mình đang nghiêm túc rà soát và chấn chỉnh lại quy trình làm việc để tránh lặp lại những trải nghiệm tương tự.

Nếu bạn cho phép, quán rất mong được mời bạn quay lại để bù đắp cho trải nghiệm chưa trọn vẹn này. Bạn có thể nhắn tin trực tiếp qua instagram của quán, bên mình sẽ hỗ trợ và sắp xếp phục vụ bạn chu đáo hơn trong lần ghé sau.

Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì đã dành thời gian góp ý thẳng thắn cho quán. Mong sẽ có cơ hội được đón tiếp và phục vụ bạn tốt hơn.

I ordered the cheapest course and then added some extra dishes.

If I ever come back to Da Nang, I will definitely visit this restaurant again. Thank you very much.

text:
Thật ra mình không hay viết review lắm, nhưng ghé Linger Bespoke xong thấy muốn để lại vài dòng.
Không gian ở đây có cái gì đó khác — không cố tình trendy nhưng lại có gu thật sự. Ngồi vào là thấy dễ chịu, không phải kiểu decor chỉ đẹp trên ảnh.
Cocktail mình gọi được pha khá cẩn thận, vị cân bằng, không bị ngọt hoặc gắng sức. Nhân viên tư vấn tự nhiên, hỏi thì trả lời được, không bị cảm giác đang bị bán hàng.
Nếu có điểm nào muốn cải thiện thì có lẽ là thêm lựa chọn non-alcoholic một chút — nhưng nhìn chung đây là một trong những bar ở Đà Nẵng mình thấy đáng quay lại nhất.
textTranslated:
I don't usually write reviews, but after visiting Linger Bespoke, I felt like leaving a few words.

The atmosphere here is something different — not intentionally trendy, but genuinely stylish. It's comfortable to sit in; the decor isn't just pretty in pictures.
The cocktail I ordered was carefully mixed, with a balanced flavor that wasn't overly sweet or forced. The staff were natural and helpful, answering my questions without feeling like they were trying to sell me anything.
If there's anything that could be improved, it would probably be adding more non-alcoholic options — but overall, this is one of the bars in Da Nang that I find most worth returning to.

text:
​Linger Bespoke Bar is a must-visit in Da Nang for anyone who appreciates a truly personalized drink. There’s no set menu here; instead, the bartenders craft cocktails based entirely on what your taste buds crave.
​What makes them stand out is their use of unique local ingredients. They incorporate elements like Hạt Dổi (“black gold”) to bring out incredible natural flavors, giving their drinks a woody, earthy depth that is uniquely Vietnamese. The "flat bar" setup makes the experience feel intimate and interactive, as you watch the mixologists work their magic right in front of you.
​Intimate, soulful, and perfectly tailored—easily the best cocktail spot in the city.
responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Nga T! We're so glad you think Linger Bespoke Bar is a must-visit in Da Nang. Since we have no set menu, we really love crafting a personalized drink based on exactly what you’re craving. It’s awesome that you appreciated the Hạt Dổi—we’re big fans of using unique local ingredients to get those earthy, Vietnamese flavors. I’m happy the "flat bar" setup made the experience feel intimate and interactive for you. Thanks for calling us the best cocktail spot in the city! Best regards, The Team

text:
まさかのダナンで本格的な日本のお鮨を食べられるとは思っていなかったので、ある意味期待以上で最高でした！日本人の大将が同郷の方でまさか異国の地でこんなご縁があるとは驚きで、ダナンの地魚と地元ネタで話がはずみました。コースはとてもコスパ良く、かなり美味しかったです。ベトナム料理に飽きて日本食が恋しくなった方にオススメです。
ぜひまたダナンに来たら寄らせていただきます！
textTranslated:
I never expected to find authentic Japanese sushi in Da Nang, so it exceeded my expectations and was fantastic! The Japanese chef was from the same hometown as me, which was a pleasant surprise, and we had a great conversation about local Da Nang fish and other local topics. The course was excellent value for money and incredibly delicious. I highly recommend it to anyone tired of Vietnamese food and craving Japanese cuisine.

I will definitely visit again when I come back to Da Nang!

text:
とても心地よい時間を過ごさせていただきました。

お寿司の美味しさはもちろんですが、何より大将のお人柄が素晴らしく、カウンターでの時間そのものが印象に残るお店です。

一品一品、丁寧に料理の説明してくださりながら提供していただけるのも嬉しく、その時期の美味しい現地のネタをしっかり楽しめました。

今回は一人でカウンター利用でしたが、日本酒「真澄」をボトルで頂き、おつまみ2品にお任せ握り、茶碗蒸しまでしっかり楽しんで、これで約1万円ほど。
正直、この内容でこの価格はかなり良心的だと思います。

ダナンでここまで満足度の高いお寿司が食べられるのはありがたいですね。またぜひ伺いたいです。
textTranslated:
I had a very pleasant time.

Of course, the sushi was delicious, but above all, the chef's personality was wonderful, and the time spent at the counter itself was memorable.

I was also pleased that each dish was carefully explained as it was served, and I was able to fully enjoy the delicious local ingredients of the season.

This time I was dining alone at the counter, and I enjoyed a bottle of Masumi sake, two appetizers, chef's choice sushi, and even chawanmushi (steamed egg custard), all for about 10,000 yen.

Honestly, I think this price is quite reasonable for what you get.

It's wonderful to be able to eat such satisfying sushi in Da Nang. I would definitely like to visit again.
responseFromOwnerText:
ご来店誠にありがとうございます。

コストパフォーマンスについても「良心的」とのお言葉をいただき、ありがとうございます。これからも「この内容でこの価格ならまた来たい」と思っていただけるよう、品質とサービスの向上に励んでまいります。

またダナンにお越しの際は、ぜひお立ち寄りください。次回も美味しいお酒と季節のネタをご用意して、心よりお待ちしております！

text:
Mình cùng gia đình chọn nhà hàng Sushi-Bê ăn tối vào những ngày cuối năm.Đặt bàn 6 người sẽ có phòng riêng lịch sự.Món ăn đúng hương vị Nhật Bản.Độ tươi ngon đạt chuẩn.Nhân viên phục vụ cũng dễ thương.Món ăn lên đúng trình tự và liên tục.Cuối buổi cũng có tráng miệng đi kèm.
Về giá các món ăn có thể cao hơn những nhà hàng Nhật khác nhưng về chất lượng cũng như dịch vụ thì mình cảm thấy tương xứng.
Ở đây còn có phục vụ Omakase với các mức giá khác nhau.Có dịp mình nhất định sẽ thưởng thức qua nhé ^^.
textTranslated:
My family and I chose Sushi-Bê restaurant for dinner during the end of the year. We booked a table for 6 people and got a private, elegant room. The food was authentically Japanese, with excellent freshness and quality. The staff were also lovely. The dishes were served in the correct order and continuously. Desserts were also included at the end of the meal.

While the prices might be higher than other Japanese restaurants, I felt the quality and service were worth it.

They also serve Omakase (a type of Japanese salad) at different price points. I'll definitely try it sometime! ^^
responseFromOwnerText: Cảm ơn quý khách đã lựa chọn SUSHI-Bê 鮨兵衛 cho bữa tối cuối năm cùng gia đình! Chúng tôi rất vui khi quý khách hài lòng về hương vị Nhật Bản chính thống, độ tươi ngon của món ăn cũng như dịch vụ phục vụ. Rất mong được đón tiếp quý khách trong trải nghiệm Omakase sắp tới. Chúc quý khách và gia đình luôn mạnh khỏe, hạnh phúc!
address: 38 Nguyen Chi Thanh, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam
title: SUSHI-Bê

text:
ダナンで初めて和食食べました!!
このお店は日本人オーナーのようで、材料も地元の食材と日本から取り寄せたものを使って提供しています🎶
おまかせコースをお願いしました
先付、手巻き、お造り、握り、茶碗蒸し、寿司、巻物、玉子、汁物、甘味と、どれも見た目も味も値段(この内容でものすごく安い)も大満足でした。
美味しすぎて写真撮り忘れまくりでした笑
ダナンに行ったら絶対利用したいお店です!!
textTranslated:
It was my first time eating Japanese food in Da Nang!!
This restaurant appears to be owned by a Japanese person, and they use a mix of local ingredients and those imported from Japan. 🎶
I ordered the omakase course.
From the appetizer, temaki (hand rolls), sashimi, nigiri (sushi), chawanmushi (savory egg custard), sushi, rolls, egg, soup, and dessert, everything was delicious, from appearance to taste to price (which was incredibly reasonable for what you get).
It was so delicious that I kept forgetting to take photos, lol.
This is a restaurant I'll definitely visit again when I visit Da Nang!!
responseFromOwnerText: この度は SUSHI-Bê 鮨兵衛 にご来店いただき、誠にありがとうございます。おまかせコースをお楽しみいただけたようで、大変嬉しく存じます。一品一品丁寧にご提供させていただいておりますので、ご満足いただけて何よりでございます。写真を撮り忘れるほど夢中になっていただけたとのこと、料理人冥利に尽きます。ダナンにお越しの際は、ぜひまたお立ち寄りくださいませ。心よりお待ちしております。
address: 38 Nguyen Chi Thanh, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam

text:
ダナン旅行の疲れた胃袋を救ってくれた、魂の寿司屋さん！🍣✨
ダナンに来て連日ピザやパスタ、ベトナム料理を楽しんでたんですが、正直そろそろ日本の味が恋しくて…海風と観光で疲れた体に「あー、ちゃんとした寿司が食べたい…」ってなってたところで、こちらの鮨兵衛さんを発見しました！！！
最初ね、ダナンで本格寿司って大丈夫かな？変な回転寿司に行くよりマシかな程度の期待値だったんですよ。でもカウンターに座った瞬間、空気が違った😳
まずお通しのがんもどきが出てきた時点で「あ、この店わかってるな」って確信しました🙌 大根おろしと生姜、小葱がちょこんと添えてあって、出汁がじんわり染みてて…これだけで「あ、今日は当たりだ」って体が反応しましたね笑
そこからのおまかせがもう怒涛でした！！！
🐟大トロ→ 包丁の入れ方が美しすぎて写真撮りまくりました！口に入れた瞬間とろける脂の甘さ…ダナンでこのレベル食べられるとは思わなかった😭✨
🐟**鯵（アジ）**→ 皮目の処理が丁寧すぎる！新鮮さがビリビリ伝わってくる一貫でした
🐟サーモン→ 漬けにしてあるのかな？照りが美しくて、ネタの厚みもちょうどいい！
🐟白身魚たち（クエ、コトヒキ、チヌ等）→ 次々出てくる白身の変化球がすごい！一貫一貫違う味わいで飽きない！ダナンの地魚も使ってるのかな？
🐟イカ→ 透明感がすごくて、包丁の仕事が繊細！格子の飾り包丁が入ってて見た目も美しい
🐟炙り→ 上にネギと梅？が乗ってて香ばしさと爽やかさのバランスが最高
そしてつまみ系も充実しすぎ！！！
🦐きびなごの唐揚げ→ カリッカリでライムを絞ると最高のおつまみ！これだけでサッポロ3杯いける笑
🐡白子の天ぷら→ 2月だからこその旬の味！外はサクッ、中はトロッで幸せの極み😍

textTranslated:
A soulful sushi restaurant that saved my weary Da Nang trip! 🍣✨
I'd been enjoying pizza, pasta, and Vietnamese food every day since coming to Da Nang, but honestly, I was starting to miss the flavors of Japan... The sea breeze and my body tired from sightseeing left me thinking, "Ah, I want some proper sushi..." That's when I discovered Sushibei!!!
At first, I wondered if authentic sushi in Da Nang was even possible. I was hoping it would be better than some weird conveyor-belt sushi place. But the moment I sat down at the counter, the atmosphere was different. 😳
As soon as the appetizer of tofu arrived, I knew, "Ah, this place knows what they're doing!" 🙌 It was garnished with grated daikon radish, ginger, and green onions, and the broth was gently seeping in... That alone was enough to make my body know, "Ah, today's the day!" lol
Then, the omakase menu was just overwhelming!!! 🐟 Fatty tuna → The way the knife cuts the tuna was so beautiful I took tons of photos! The sweetness of the fat melted in my mouth the moment I put it in... I never thought I'd find food of this caliber in Da Nang 😭✨
🐟 **Horse mackerel** → The skin was so carefully prepared! You could really taste the freshness in every bite.
🐟 Salmon → I wonder if it's marinated? The shine is beautiful, and the thickness of the toppings is just right!
🐟 White fish (grouper, sardine, black porgy, etc.) → The variety of white fish that comes out one after another is amazing! Every bite has a different flavor, so you never get bored! I wonder if they use local Da Nang fish?
🐟 Squid → The squid is so transparent, and the knife work is so delicate! The lattice-patterned knife cut makes it look beautiful.
🐟 Grilled squid → Topped with green onions and plums? The balance of savory and refreshing is perfect.
And the snack menu is also amazing! !!!
🦐Fried Silver Herring → Crispy and with a squeeze of lime, it's the perfect snack! I could drink three Sapporo beers with just this! lol
🐡Shirako Tempura → A seasonal taste that's only available in February! Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, it's the ultimate happiness!😍
🐠Flying Fish Namero → Eat it wrapped in nori seaweed! The aroma of sesame and green onions is exquisite, and isn't 120,000 VND too cheap for this?!
🐟Monkfish Liver Ponzu → A perfect match with grated daikon radish and green onions. A winter luxury...
🐟Shirasu Okizuke → The raw whitebait sparkled in a small bowl, like a jewel box!✨
🐟Grilled Silver Cod Saikyo Style → This is also delicious!!!! The sweetness of the Nishikyo miso and the fat of the silver cod combined to keep me going over the rice. 🍚
🍳Dashimaki Tamago → Fluffy and juicy with dashi broth. Served with shiso leaves and grated daikon radish. I wonder why tamagoyaki (rolled omelet) at sushi restaurants is so delicious.
🍜Inaniwa Udon → The relief of having this as the final dish... Served in a refreshing bamboo bowl, it was incredibly smooth and delicious.
🍣Salmon Roll → The combination with mayonnaise adds a touch of casual flavor, creating a wonderful sense of balance.
The chef's work is incredibly meticulous, and you can really feel the passion he puts into each and every bite. Just watching him make sushi across the counter is soul-cleansing. 🥹
The bill for two came to about 4 million VND (about ¥24,000). A similar omakase meal in Japan would easily cost over ¥15,000 per person, so this was fantastic value! !!!
To all the Japanese people in Da Nang who are thinking, "Oh, fried seafood again...", please come here!!! Before going to some weird conveyor-belt sushi chain, definitely choose this place!!! You'll have a truly soul-cleansing dining experience🙏✨
I'll definitely be back! Thank you, chef, for the wonderful time!!! 🍣🇻🇳❤️

text: Spent time looking for a sushi restaurant that seemed to be more of higher quality and professional for my family. Didn’t even make it through the door. Unfortunately grab after grab kept cancelling yesterday so they ended up being a little bit late but out of courtesy had called in advance to let the restaurant know. The gentleman on the line was very rude and upon arrival had shut the door in their face while another worker went to go check on availability. During this time, instead of helping them who got there first they sat another party that arrived after them. Almost appeared to have been better if they had not called to begin with and just showed up. It was like he was looking for someone to take out some pent up anger on yesterday. Very disappointing and will not be recommending this to anyone in the future.
responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Guest,

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention. Please accept our sincerest apologies for the deeply disappointing and unprofessional experience your family had with us.

We are truly mortified to hear about the conduct you described. Calling in advance to inform us of a delay due to transportation issues is a courtesy we highly appreciate, and it is inexcusable that you were met with rudeness instead of understanding. Shutting the door on a guest and seating another party ahead of you is completely contrary to the standards of hospitality we strive to uphold.

We take your feedback very seriously. We will be conducting a thorough internal investigation regarding the staff members involved to understand why this happened and to ensure such an incident is never repeated.

Once again, we are truly sorry for the lack of respect shown to your family and for ruining what should have been a special evening.

Sincerely,
The Management

text:
My partner didnt believe there was a good sushi restaurant in da nang. I wanted to prove her wrong with sushi bê but it ended up a disaster 🤣🤣

Food:
- There were a few good dishes, but they couldn’t make up for the others. The hamachi should have been firm and creamy, but what we were served was soft and bland. As a big fan of hamachi, I was pretty disappointed.
- The steamed egg custard was too watery and had an off-putting smell.
- The akimo, my favorite dish, was a major letdown. It lacked the usual creaminess and was bland. The liver fell apart even before I touched it.
- I have to admit, their uni roll was pretty good.
- The sashimi boat and seared nigiri were decent, but definitely didn’t justify their premium price tag.

Service:
- The server seemed confused by the menu, which was quite funny. They tried to be welcoming, but their training was clearly lacking. It was amusing that the chef saw us before the waitress even noticed we had arrived.
I had to ask multiple times for them to clean up my dishes.

Location:
- It’s in the heart of Da Nang, so it’s easy to find.
- I loved their decor.

text:
Mình đến Sushibe từ những ngày đầu quán còn nằm ở đường Bạch Đằng. Năm nào mình cũng về ĐN để ghé ăn hơn 10 năm rồi.
Tuy Chef có thay đổi nhưng chất lượng vẫn được giữ vững.
Phần cơm mềm dẻo, độ kết dính nhất định, gia vị thấm đều.
Phần cá được phi lê tốt, Chef đã cố ý giữ lại lớp mỡ trắng tự nhiên marbling để tăng độ béo và ngậy tan trong miệng.
Tuy chưa đến mức cao cấp như những nhà hàng mình từng trải nghiệm, nhưng Sushibe vẫn là lựa chọn tốt nhất khi mình muốn thưởng thức Sashimi hay Nigiri ở ĐN.

Chất lượng tương xứng vs giá thành
Must try và mãi yêuuu 😍
textTranslated:
I've been going to Sushibe since the early days when the restaurant was still located on Bach Dang Street. Every year, I've returned to Da Nang to eat there for over 10 years.

Although the chef has changed, the quality remains consistent.

The rice is soft and sticky, with a certain consistency and evenly seasoned.

The fish is well-filleted; the chef intentionally left the natural white marbling to enhance the richness and melt-in-your-mouth flavor.

While not as high-end as some of the restaurants I've experienced, Sushibe is still my best choice when I want to enjoy Sashimi or Nigiri in Da Nang.

The quality matches the price.
Must try and I'll always love it! 😍
